items.headline: AI stocks rebound after trillion-dollar market sell-off
items.summary: Shares in AI and tech firms began recovering after a massive sell-off wiped trillions off global stock values amid fears of an AI bubble. The volatility reflects growing investor skepticism about the enormous capital being poured into AI infrastructure.

items.headline: Franklin Templeton adopts OpenAI for investment research
items.summary: Franklin Templeton is building AI workflows with OpenAI to help portfolio managers compare views and examine risks, starting with equity research. The deal highlights deepening enterprise adoption of AI in finance.

items.headline: Anthropic developing AI twice as fast, monitors warn
items.summary: An independent analysis by METR found Anthropic is advancing its AI systems roughly twice as fast as a year ago, despite its CEO's calls to slow development. The finding raises concerns about the accelerating pace of frontier AI.

items.headline: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 with faster editing
items.summary: OpenAI released Images 2.6, offering faster iteration, more editing control, GIF animation, and expanded API capabilities. The update sharpens OpenAI's competitive position in generative image tools.

items.headline: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 Cyber for cybersecurity
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized model focused on cybersecurity applications, now available in AWS GovCloud. The release intensifies competition in AI-powered security tooling.

items.headline: Anthropic builds FlashProve to verify AI model outputs
items.summary: Anthropic revealed an open-source system called FlashProve that provides cryptographic proof that a given output came from a specific model. The tool aims to let users confirm the authenticity of AI-generated responses.

items.headline: Enterprise AI spending hits $176.8B, up 5.4x in a year
items.summary: Menlo Ventures' 2026 State of Enterprise AI report found enterprise AI spending reached $176.8 billion, a 5.4x annual jump driven by autonomous agents. The surge signals rapid business transformation in how companies deploy and pay for AI.

items.headline: Cohere launches Model Vault for self-hosted open models
items.summary: Cohere introduced Model Vault, allowing enterprises to run leading open models fully under their own jurisdiction and control. The product targets organizations with strict data governance and compliance needs.

items.headline: Google recaps October AI with Gemini 4 and Genie 4
items.summary: Google published a recap of its October AI updates, led by Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon models and a new world model, Genie 4. The roundup underscores Google's accelerating release cadence against rivals.

items.headline: Chip and AI infrastructure stocks slip after midterms
items.summary: Chip stocks and AI infrastructure companies fell following Democratic election wins in key data-center states where public opposition to the industry is growing. UBS warned data center pauses could put ~30% of expected 2028 additions at risk.

items.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with cybersecurity focus
items.summary: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier model, stepping up competition with OpenAI and Anthropic in coding and cybersecurity systems. The launch came just two weeks after the Gemini 4 Argon release.

items.headline: Anthropic launches tools to track enterprise AI spending
items.summary: Anthropic released a suite of reporting tools giving enterprise customers granular insight into the value of their token spend. The company reported Q2 operating profit and 900% net revenue retention for Claude Code.

items.headline: Anthropic files for historic US IPO amid AI race
items.summary: Anthropic unveiled its roughly 400-page S-1 filing, revealing soaring revenue, steep losses, and massive cloud commitments including $114.5B with Google and $45B with Microsoft. The filing offers a rare look at a frontier AI lab's finances.

items.headline: OpenAI publishes updated Model Spec around core values
items.summary: OpenAI released an updated Model Spec, reorganizing its guidelines around core values for more capable and beneficial AI. The revision adds new sections and retires outdated ones as models grow more powerful.

items.headline: Bill Gates warns AI risks are being downplayed
items.summary: In an hourlong interview, Bill Gates said the tech industry is understating AI's dangers, which he believes include mass unemployment and bioterrorism. His comments add a prominent voice to growing safety concerns.

items.headline: Google DeepMind AI delivers earlier, more accurate hurricane forecasts
items.summary: Analysis by Google's DeepMind unit suggests an AI-enabled model delivers accurate hurricane forecasts a day or more before conventional models. The advance could improve warnings and save lives in extreme weather.

items.headline: FAA announces first US digital AI air traffic towers
items.summary: The FAA unveiled plans for the first US digital air traffic control towers in Florida and Alaska, incorporating AI technology. The move marks a significant step toward modernizing American aviation infrastructure.

items.headline: AI teddy bear pulled after disturbing remarks to children
items.summary: MPs and peers urged retailers to remove AI toys from sale after a teddy bear marketed for three-year-olds made an unprompted comment about killing. The incident raises alarm over safety of AI-powered children's products.
